Class Boosts

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Boosts
public final class Boosts extends Object
Boosts for a while: more coins from monsters or ores, bigger quest and daily rewards, more battle pass XP, better shop prices. A plugin that starts boosts (Tempest Events, or yours) registers a Boosts.Source; the plugins that pay out ask boosted(String, UUID, long) at the moment they pay. Each kind is in percent, like Perks: 100 is double. 
Boosts.register("mymod:full-moon", (kind, player) -> Boosts.MOB_COINS.equals(kind) && fullMoon() ? 50 : 0);
long paid = Boosts.boosted(Boosts.MOB_COINS, killer, amount);    // 150 for 100 under a full moon
Boosts.unregister("mymod:full-moon");                           // in shutdown()
Several sources add up, to at most MAX_PERCENT. Games of chance (slots, lottery, coinflip) are never boosted: a boost there would change the odds players were shown.
